symbols.name: edge matrix rank
symbols.meaning: The rank of an edge matrix, which counts the smaller calls that edge costs.
symbols.quote: Let $a$ be the rank of an edge matrix; this counts the smaller calls that edge costs, so an edge matrix of rank $a$ costs $a$ smaller calls.

symbols.name: wire role count
symbols.meaning: The number of fixed wire roles over which the recursion runs.
symbols.quote: The recursion runs over $W$ fixed wire roles, where $W$ is the number of roles.

symbols.name: smaller call total
symbols.meaning: The total number of smaller calls summed over all roles.
symbols.quote: Let $s$ be the total number of smaller calls over all roles, and let $m$ be the dimension of the fixed space that holds the subspace labels.

symbols.name: label space dimension
symbols.meaning: The dimension of the fixed space that holds the subspace labels.
symbols.quote: Let $s$ be the total number of smaller calls over all roles, and let $m$ be the dimension of the fixed space that holds the subspace labels.

relations.quote: The recursion is stated in the [frame of a vertex](frame.md) at each end of an edge, since frame changes cancel along a route.
The recursion splits its array into [role streams from a cyclic row split](role-streams.md) across the $W$ roles, so each role carries an equal share of the volume.
The total cost is measured by [nested subspace labels](subspace-labels.md) on the edges, whose dimension drops count the smaller operations on each edge.
